title: Holley Inc. 8-K Filing — Departure of Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
summary: Holley Inc. filed a Form 8-K announcing the departure of Carly Kennedy from her role as Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary. Ms. Kennedy will remain employed until May 15, 2026 to facilitate an orderly transition. The filing details severance terms including $164,000 in salary continuation (six months), a pro-rated 2026 annual bonus if earned, and pro rata vesting of certain RSUs. If a change in control occurs within three months of the separation date, salary continuation increases to $328,000.
key_points: Carly Kennedy, EVP, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary at Holley Inc., departing effective May 15, 2026
Severance package includes $164,000 salary continuation (six months) or $328,000 if change in control within three months of separation
Pro-rated 2026 annual bonus payable if earned based on actual financial results, due by March 15, 2027
Pro rata vesting of first tranche of RSUs granted August 12, 2025; all other outstanding awards terminate at separation
Separation Agreement and General Release filed as Exhibit 10.1
